evidence.quote: Owned intelligence is not the same as rented intelligence.

observations.why: Contrasts shared or retained ownership with an externally rented relationship, carrying an ownership boundary but no specific hierarchy or exchange rule.

evidence.quote: The substrate is a commodity; the perspective is the asset you keep.

observations.why: Frames the relationship through differentiated asset value and retention, a proportionality and possession logic rather than rank or reciprocity.
